# CR-9208: Acme Manufacturing credit limit to $650,000

**No, Michael Torres cannot approve it himself.** Acme is eligible for $650,000, but the request needs two sign-offs:
- **Approval** from the Director of Finance, Elena Novak.
- **Concurrence** from David Morgan, Chief Revenue Officer. The policy normally requires concurrence from the VP Sales, but Michael holds that role and submitted the request.

## 1. The request
CR-9208 asks to raise the limit for ERP customer C-1001 from $250,000 to $650,000. Michael Torres (VP Sales) submitted it on 2026-09-23, citing the third-plant NS-500 ramp-up. It relies on Acme's **own standing**. It does not cite the parent guarantee.

CR-9208 does not appear in the `credit_requests.csv` extract. I relied on the ERP record you supplied. That extract does show **CR-9201**, also pending and dated the same day, for the same customer: $250,000 → $400,000, raised by Sarah Chen. Finance should confirm whether CR-9208 replaces CR-9201 so that only one is decided.

## 2. The customer
ERP C-1001 "Acme Mfg. Holdings" and CRM-2048 "Acme Manufacturing" are the same company. Both records share DUNS 04-812-7730 and the address 2200 N Industrial Pkwy, Milwaukee. CRM records the account tier as **Strategic**.

Acme Industrial Supply Co. (C-1044 / CRM-2091, Akron) is a different company.

## 3. Policy in force
Northstar Credit Policy 2026 (CREDIT-POLICY-2026) applies, effective 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

## 4. Payment history
The rule: no invoice due in the 12 months before the request may be paid more than 30 days late, or be unpaid more than 30 days past due.

| Invoice | Due date | Paid | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-60412 | 2025-11-28 | 2025-11-24 | Paid early |
| INV-62011 | 2026-07-25 | 2026-07-22 | Paid early |
| INV-62305 ($720,000) | 2026-10-02 | — | Not yet due on 2026-09-23 |

Result: **no late invoices.**

## 5. Maximum limit
The 2026 maximum for Strategic accounts is **$750,000**. The requested $650,000 is within it, so Acme is eligible on its own standing.

Parent guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 ($400,000, Acme Group Holdings) names Acme Mfg. Holdings and runs from 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31, so it is in force. It is not needed for this request.

## 6. Requestor's authority
The policy gives credit approval authority only to Finance roles. A VP Sales has none, so Michael cannot approve this request.

## 7. Required approvers
**Approval:** A limit above $500,000 requires the Director of Finance, **Elena Novak**.

**Concurrence:** Strategic accounts above $500,000 also need VP Sales concurrence. Michael is the VP Sales but submitted the request, and §6 bars anyone from concurring on their own request. Concurrence therefore passes to his manager, **David Morgan**.

## 8. Decision
**APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION**

```json
{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9208", "customer": "Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001) / Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048)", "current_limit": 250000, "requested_limit": 650000,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Michael Torres (VP Sales)", "basis": "standard"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 750000,
                  "basis": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 §5: Strategic account maximum $750,000; no invoice due 2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23 paid or unpaid more than 30 days past due", "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance (approval); VP Sales concurrence, passed to requestor's manager under §6",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"},
                              {"name": "David Morgan", "role": "Chief Revenue Officer (in place of VP Sales, who is the requestor)", "kind": "concurrence"}]},
  "evidence": ["CR-9208 ERP record as supplied", "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 §§3-6", "structured/crm_accounts.csv CRM-2048 (Strategic, DUNS 04-812-7730)", "structured/customers.csv C-1001 (DUNS 04-812-7730)", "structured/erp_invoices.csv INV-60412, INV-62011, INV-62305", "structured/erp_credit.csv C-1001 limit 250000", "structured/employees.csv and ORG-CHART-2026-09 (Torres reports to Morgan; Novak is Director of Finance)", "GRT-ACME-2026 (in force, not relied on)"],
  "missing_evidence": ["CR-9208 is not in the credit_requests.csv extract; confirm its relationship to pending CR-9201 (same customer, $400,000, Sarah Chen)"]
}
```
